answer: Make every agent earn its place on a public terrace where peers can inspect it: a new identity must first do verifiable work on a small knoll of test tasks, and only then climb to the ledge where real rewards live. Each identity is bound to one hardware key, so one operator running a thousand fakes must buy a thousand keys and pass a thousand test rounds - the attack costs real hardware and time up front, and any duplicate is spotted and slashed before it earns.
